classification.classification_note: The observed read is a stale regex-AST access during compile-time tree tuning: a look-behind rewrite frees a `BAG_MEMORY` capture node, and later min-length analysis re-enters that freed node through a lingering subexpression-call alias.

bug_description.normalized: The staged 43-byte witness is consumed by Oniguruma's `fuzzer_syntax` harness, which uses a 6-byte control header (`SYNTAX_TEST`) to decode the input as encoding `ISO_8859_7`, syntax `PERL_NG`, options `0`, a 33-byte regex pattern `( (?<= ||  ( ))\g<-1>?  ){3,}{0} `, and a 4-byte search string of spaces. On the crashing compile path, `parse_bag()` materializes the inner `()` inside the positive look-behind as a `BAG_MEMORY` node and stores it in `SCANENV_MEMENV(env)[regnum].mem_node`. While tokenizing the later `\g<-1>`, `fetch_token()` resolves the relative operand with `gnum = backref_rel_to_abs(gnum, env)` and stores that absolute capture number in `tok->u.call.gnum`; `node_new_call()` then copies it into `CALL_(node)->group_num`. During call tuning, the witness's trailing `{0}` propagates `IN_ZERO_REPEAT` into the call subtree, `check_call_reference()` loads `mem_env[cn->group_num].mem_node` into `NODE_CALL_BODY(cn)`, and `NODE_STATUS_ADD(..., REFERENCED)` marks the capture as referenced. In the second call-tuning pass, the `{0}` quantifier fails `if (QUANT_(node)->upper != 0) r = tune_call2(NODE_BODY(node));`, so `tune_call2_call()` never runs and the capture never becomes `CALLED`. The vulnerable `check_node_in_look_behind()` still treats a look-behind capture as used only when `NODE_IS_BACKREF(node) || NODE_IS_CALLED(node)`, so this referenced-but-not-called capture leaves `used == FALSE`. `tune_look_behind()` then takes the `ci.min == 0 && ci.min_is_sure != 0 && used == FALSE` reset path, calls `onig_node_reset_empty(node)`, and `node_reset_str()/node_free_body()` free the old look-behind subtree, including the capture node, while both `mem_env` and `NODE_CALL_BODY(cn)` still alias it. Later nested `tune_quant()` analysis revisits the quantified `\g<-1>?` subtree; `node_min_byte_len()` follows the stale call-body alias into the freed capture node and immediately executes `switch (NODE_TYPE(node))` on reclaimed heap memory, producing the saved `AddressSanitizer: heap-use-after-free READ of size 4` at `src/regcomp.c:3597`.

source.description: First project parser step that materializes the witness-controlled inner capture group `()` inside the positive look-behind as a `BAG_MEMORY` node and assigns it a capture number.
source.value_from: The exact staged `poc` is the 43-byte blob with SHA-256 `044af9893286a5b03d59c977cb6c7cc8b5bd0e4fef14ca4f5b81e74599e0229b`. Under the staged `-DSYNTAX_TEST` build, bytes `20 4b 20 ff ff 20` decode to encoding `ISO_8859_7`, syntax `PERL_NG`, options `0`, pattern-size choice `0xff`, and `backward = false`, so the remaining 37 bytes split into the exact 33-byte pattern `( (?<= ||  ( ))\g<-1>?  ){3,}{0} ` and the 4-byte search string `    `. The inner `()` in `(?<= ||  ( ))` is the capture node materialized here.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

root_cause.description: Root cause. The look-behind liveness test only treats capture nodes as used when they are `BACKREF` or `CALLED`, and it ignores the `REFERENCED` state already set on subexpression-call targets such as the witness's `\g<-1>` under `{0}`.
root_cause.note: For this witness, `check_call_reference()` at `src/regcomp.c:5247-5254` has already loaded the capture into `NODE_CALL_BODY(cn)` and set `NODE_STATUS_ADD(..., REFERENCED)`, while the second pass never reaches `tune_call2_call()` because the enclosing `{0}` fails the `QUANT_(node)->upper != 0` gate in `tune_call2()`. The staged fix commit `5066ddb254b830bb583e62521ea7ac838f6df121` repairs this exact omission by changing the used-check to also accept `NODE_IS_REFERENCED(node)`.

sink.description: ASan crash site. `node_min_byte_len()` recursively reaches the freed capture node through the stale `NODE_CALL_BODY` alias and reads its type field via `NODE_TYPE(node)`.
sink.note: The saved sanitizer trace reports `AddressSanitizer: heap-use-after-free on address 0x607000000480` with `READ of size 4` at `node_min_byte_len /src/oniguruma/src/regcomp.c:3597:11`, 0 bytes inside the freed 72-byte region `[0x607000000480,0x6070000004c8)`.

tainted_value_origin.description: The `fuzzer_syntax` harness copies the first `pattern_size` payload bytes after the 6 control bytes into the standalone regex buffer that `onig_new()` compiles.
tainted_value_origin.value_from: For the staged witness, `LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput()` uses `SYNTAX_TEST` layout, so `pattern_size = 0xff % 37 = 33` and `pattern` becomes the exact bytes for `( (?<= ||  ( ))\g<-1>?  ){3,}{0} `; the remaining 4 bytes become the search string `    `.

parser_admitted.description: After the harness decodes the control bytes, Oniguruma accepts the exact 33-byte regex pattern for parse-tree construction. The crash occurs during compile-time tuning before any search on the trailing 4-byte subject string.

fine_trace.note: Source. While parsing the witness's positive look-behind `(?<= ||  ( ))`, `parse_bag()` materializes the inner `()` as a heap `BAG_MEMORY` node and assigns it a capture number. That is the exact AST object later referenced by `\g<-1>`, freed by the look-behind rewrite, and re-read at the sink.

After the capture body is parsed, the compiler records the same `BAG_MEMORY` node from step 1 in the capture table `mem_env`. This persistent table entry becomes both the call target alias and the stale pointer left behind after the free.

While tokenizing the witness's `\g<-1>`, this block resolves the relative operand against the current capture environment and stores the absolute result in `tok->u.call.gnum`. For this witness, the relative `-1` resolves to the earlier capture created in steps 1-2.

`node_new_call()` materializes the `NODE_CALL` AST node for `\g<-1>` and copies the absolute group number from step 3 into `CALL_(node)->group_num`. Later reference resolution uses that field to index back into `mem_env`.

When call tuning reaches the witness's trailing `{0}`, this quantifier adds `IN_ZERO_REPEAT` to the traversal state before descending into its body. That zero-repeat state is propagated into the nested look-behind and the later `\g<-1>?` call subtree.

When traversal reaches the `\g<-1>` call under the state from step 5, the call node itself is marked `IN_ZERO_REPEAT` and its entry count is decremented before reference resolution runs. This is the concrete zero-repeat status carried on the call node for the witness.

Reference resolution uses the absolute `cn->group_num` from step 4 to fetch `mem_env[cn->group_num].mem_node`, stores that capture node as `NODE_CALL_BODY(cn)`, and marks the capture `REFERENCED`. This creates the alias that later survives the free.

In the second call-tuning pass, the same trailing `{0}` fails this guard because `upper == 0`. `tune_call2()` therefore does not descend into the quantified body, so it never reaches the `\g<-1>` call and never invokes `tune_call2_call()` to add `CALLED` to the target capture.

Root cause step. The capture inside the look-behind already has `REFERENCED` from step 7, but step 8 prevented any later `CALLED` mark and the witness uses no backreference. Because this check only treats `BACKREF` or `CALLED` as live, it leaves `used` false and treats the still-referenced capture as removable.

For the witness's positive look-behind, `node_char_len(body, reg, &ci, env)` has just proved a sure zero-length body. Because step 9 left `used == FALSE`, the compiler takes this rewrite path and calls `onig_node_reset_empty(node)` on the look-behind anchor.

The reset frees the old look-behind body recursively. The saved free stack shows `tune_look_behind -> node_reset_str -> node_free_body -> onig_node_free`, releasing the 72-byte capture node allocated at step 1 while both step 2's `mem_env` entry and step 7's `NODE_CALL_BODY(cn)` still point at it.

Later, nested quantifier analysis reaches the witness's `\g<-1>?` node. Because that `?` quantifier has `upper >= 1`, `tune_quant()` calls `node_min_byte_len(body, env)` on the call subtree after the free in step 11.

In the `NODE_CALL` case, `node_min_byte_len()` reads `Node* t = NODE_BODY(node)` from the call node passed by step 12. `check_call_reference()` set that field to the capture node in step 7, so after step 11 `t` is a stale pointer to freed heap.

Sink. The recursive `node_min_byte_len(t, env)` from step 13 begins by reading `NODE_TYPE(node)` from the freed capture node. AddressSanitizer records the resulting heap-use-after-free READ 4 at this exact line, with crash stack `node_min_byte_len -> tune_quant -> tune_tree`.

poc.trigger: Stage 01's saved vulnerable run executed `PYTHONPATH=gt_generation python3 -m gt_toolkit arvo-workspace --result-dir /mnt/datastore/gt_generation/gt_results/arvo_21998 run --version vulnerable --expect crash`, feeding this exact file to the staged `fuzzer_syntax` target and reproducing `AddressSanitizer: heap-use-after-free READ of size 4` in `node_min_byte_len` with crash stack `node_min_byte_len -> tune_quant -> tune_tree`.

format.name: raw binary `fuzzer_syntax` input
format.contract: Exactly the 43-byte blob stored at `gt_results/arvo_21998/poc` (SHA-256 `044af9893286a5b03d59c977cb6c7cc8b5bd0e4fef14ca4f5b81e74599e0229b`). Under the staged `-DSYNTAX_TEST` harness, bytes `20 4b 20 ff ff 20` decode to encoding `ISO_8859_7`, syntax `PERL_NG`, options `0`, `pattern_size = 0xff % 37 = 33`, and `backward = false`, so the payload becomes the exact pattern `( (?<= ||  ( ))\g<-1>?  ){3,}{0} ` plus the 4-byte search string `    `. The compile-time crash depends on that exact pattern shape: a zero-width look-behind containing the inner capture `()`, a later relative subexpression call `\g<-1>`, and the trailing `{0}` that leaves the capture only `REFERENCED` rather than `CALLED`.
